faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers about deposits, fees, verification and withdrawals on Void2Empire.
faq.q_deposit: How do I deposit funds into my account?
faq.a_deposit: Open Wallet, choose Deposit, pick the asset and the network, then send to the address shown for your account.
faq.a_fees_after: of the position's notional when opening, and the same rate again when closing. Spot and binary fee rates have not been announced yet.
faq.q_kyc: Do I need to verify my identity?
faq.q_live: Is real-money trading live right now?
faq.a_live: Not in this build. Real-money trading is switched off while the platform is prepared for launch, and Demo trading runs on virtual funds whose results carry no cash value.
faq.q_referral: How does the Referral Program work?
faq.a_referral_before: Share your unique referral link from the Referral page. Anyone who joins through it stays linked to you, and you are credited
faq.a_referral_after: of every deposit they make — on their deposits, not on their trading fees. Each credited reward is listed in the Referral Earnings table.
faq.a_withdraw_intro: They follow your verification level. A Level 1 account can withdraw up to
faq.a_withdraw_l2: , and a Level 2 account up to
faq.a_withdraw_funding: The Funding Balance is reserved for trading and cannot be withdrawn.
